node.title: Re: Grepping the filehandler
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
[doc://print] and the array assignment provide list context to the <> operator ([doc://readline]), which causes it to return all (remaining) lines from the handle, while =~ provides scalar context, which causes the operator to only return the next line - unless you set [doc://$/] to undef for slurp mode, but in this case I recommend local $/; in a new block to limit the scope of the change.

Update: [doc://grep] also provides list context, so you can say e.g. my @matching_lines = grep {/.../} <$fh>;. Also added note on [doc://local]. Added another link.
